extraction.Name: Luther Arcorn
extraction.NOTES: Received patent at the Agency Office; signed a receipt for it; sold land to Ella McHenry; was supposed to get $10,000 but only received $1500.00 at time of sale plus notes for $6000.00 ($600.00 due each year for ten years at 6% interest); received two bogus checks for $10,000; gave three notes to attorneys; notes he held were worthless; Wm. J. Bordeaux had court proceedings against the land which allottee describes as fraud, stating he had no contract or agreement with Bordeaux; McHenry allegedly maneuvered to cloud title to say land was not clear; has wife and three children whom he supports; document number 1196; notarized April 8, 1929 by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public (commission expires 4-28-32)
